title: tylanthus litoralis
intro: Tylanthus litoralis, commonly known as sea lavender, is a perennial herb native to the coastal regions of Europe. The health benefits of sea lavender include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of sea lavender include its sedative and calming effects, making it a popular ingredient in aromatherapy and skincare products. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, terpenes, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
